test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.

A delicious meal was prepared by the chef.

options.text: The chef had prepared a delicious meal.
The chef has been preparing a delicious meal.
The chef has prepared a delicious meal.
The chef prepared a delicious meal.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice and** "A delicious meal" **is the subject and **"the chef" **is the object.
 
• When we convert this sentence into active voice:
 
 
• The subject "A delicious meal" of the passive voice becomes the object.
 
• The object "the chef" of the passive voice becomes the subject. ‘**By**’ will be removed.
 
 
 
• The sentence is in the Simple past tense.
 
• The passive format **"was + prepared (V3)" **is used and the active format **"prepared (V2)"** should be used.
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the **Simple past tense.**

Hence, the correct active voice is ***"The chef prepared a delicious meal."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__

 
• In voice change, **TENSE** will **never** change.
